title: Wynn Tiny Dernic Crops
description: Turns those annoying brown crops around the dernic farming area into small ones. Original by Kilie2001.
body:
This pack changes the model of the brown dernic crops to small dernic crops. Allowing you to see more clearly when farming for hours on end. (Side note it does make the hanging roots in the outervoids look weird and segmented but who even goes to the outervoids)

Orignal pack was put together by Kilie2001.
All I did was fix it when it broke updating to a newer version.

![Photo of the crops in question](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cbb1a1b0b4dee51a5d5865e77f10f54609ce903.png)
